description: DUT generates a TCP packet containing valid header field values (RFC 793 §3.1 Header Format)
approach:
[Objective]
A DUT-emitted segment must have a structurally valid TCP header — Data Offset ≥ 5, valid checksum, sane flags. This case checks the entire header gestalt of an outgoing segment.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. DUT → Tester: data segment.
3. Observation: validate header structurally.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted segment has well-formed header.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_bad_header — header has invalid fields
• Fail_timeout — no DUT data segment within listen window

verdicts.Fail_bad_header: DUT emitted segment with invalid header
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT data segment within listen window
